epic.title: EPIC-001: Authentification & Accès Module
epic.description: L'utilisateur peut se connecter via Auth0, accéder à son organisation et voir l'état d'activation du module Mesure. Inclut la liste de rapports de base.

userStory.want: log in via Auth0 SSO and have my organization automatically resolved
userStory.so_that: I can securely access only my organization's data

acceptanceCriteria.criterion: Given a user with valid Auth0 credentials, When they authenticate via Auth0, Then the system extracts organisationId from the JWT token and sets TenantContext, all subsequent API requests are scoped to that organization, Auth0 tokens are validated on every API request
Given an unauthenticated user accessing a protected endpoint, When the request has no valid token, Then the system returns 401 Unauthorized
Given an authenticated Reader, When they attempt to access Editor-only actions (create/edit/delete report), Then the system returns 403 Forbidden

frontend.note: Already implemented in Sprint 0, no frontend work needed

userStory.want: the system to check if the Mesure module is activated for my organization
userStory.so_that: I'm redirected to the sales page if not activated, or shown the module if activated

acceptanceCriteria.criterion: Given an authenticated user whose organization does NOT have the Mesure module activated, When they navigate to the Mesure module, Then the system redirects them to the sales/upgrade page

Given an authenticated user whose organization HAS the module activated but no reports exist, When they navigate to the Mesure module, Then the system displays an empty state with illustration and "Create Report" CTA button
Given an authenticated user whose organization HAS the module activated and reports exist, When they navigate to the Mesure module, Then the system displays the report list (Story 1.3)

featureLogic: Check module activation status in organization context
Conditional routing based on activation status
uiStates: Module not activated → Redirect to sales/upgrade page
Module activated, no reports → Empty state with CTA
Module activated, reports exist → Display report list

userStory.want: view a list of all reports for my organization with status and date
userStory.so_that: I can see what's been configured and its current state

acceptanceCriteria.criterion: Given an authenticated Editor with existing reports, When they view the report list, Then the system displays report name, status badge (PENDING/CONFIGURED), creation date, number of markets, number of categories; results sorted by most recent first; list supports sorting and filtering; list is paginated (limit/offset); list loads within 1 second
Given an authenticated Reader, When they view the report list, Then they see the same list in read-only mode (no create/edit/delete actions)
Given an authenticated user from organization A, When they view the report list, Then they only see reports belonging to organization A (zero cross-tenant data)
